name: gRPC & Protocol Buffers Security Analyzer
description: Enterprise gRPC microservice and Protocol Buffers security analyzer. Discovers unauthenticated RPC procedures, evaluates public gRPC Server Reflection API exposure, extracts complete Protobuf service definitions (.proto), and audits missing transport layer security or unauthenticated administrative RPC endpoints.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

probe_reflection_api.description: Probe for exposed gRPC Server Reflection Protocol (grpc.reflection.v1alpha.ServerReflection)

dump_proto_schemas.description: Extract full Protocol Buffers service schemas and RPC message definitions

test_unauthenticated_methods.description: Test RPC methods without bearer authentication tokens
